name: REST API Connector
description: Generic REST API connector for polling data from any HTTP JSON API. Supports API key, bearer token, OAuth2, and basic authentication.
use_cases: Pull data from any REST API

entity.name: REST API
entity.description: Generic REST API connector for pulling data from HTTP JSON endpoints

placeholders.{{BASE_URL}}: HTTPS origin for the REST API (e.g., https://api.example.com). Prefer origin-only; put versioned routes in custom_settings.resource_path.
placeholders.{{AUTH_TYPE}}: Authentication type: api_key, bearer, oauth2, basic, or none
placeholders.{{API_KEY}}: API key for authentication (encrypted, if using api_key auth)
placeholders.{{BEARER_TOKEN}}: Bearer token for authentication (encrypted, if using bearer auth)
placeholders.{{OAUTH_AUTH_URL}}: OAuth2 authorization URL (if using oauth2 auth)
placeholders.{{OAUTH_TOKEN_URL}}: OAuth2 token URL (if using oauth2 auth)
placeholders.{{PAGINATION_TYPE}}: Pagination type: offset, cursor, page, or link

connector_package.description: Generic REST via CatalogRuntimeConnector. Host allowlist from connection.base_url / custom_settings.base_url (allowed_hosts_from_connection). Keep platform providers/rest-api until CatalogRuntime registration + multi-scheme auth are promoted.
follow_up_notes: execution_policy uses allowed_hosts_from_connection (not static allowed_host_suffixes) — requires platform LOX-1968 / PR #1997.
catalog_http path join uses URL resolution: absolute custom_settings.resource_path replaces any path on base_url. Prefer origin-only base_url and full paths like /v1/items in resource_path.

header_auth is Bearer via connection.oauth_access_token (falls back to connection.api_key). Covers bearer/oauth2 and api_key-as-bearer. Native providers/rest-api still owns basic, custom api_key header names, query-key placement, and auth none until CatalogRuntime multi-scheme passthrough exists.
connection_probe uses required_field "" so any JSON object (or first array element) counts as success; empty arrays still fail. Point resource_path at a probe-friendly route.
sync_plan ships a single records entity bound to custom_settings.resource_path (one resource per connection, matching native rest-api).
Platform should keep createRestApiConnector until createCatalogRuntimeConnector("rest-api") is registered and the gaps above are closed.

records.name: Records
records.description: JSON records from the configured REST request_path (array body or single object).
